meaning: 'verified' means an independent reader attested every item against the source. It does not upgrade any compliance claim, and the script cannot prove the reader's independence - it records the attestation.

verifier.statement: I extracted all 11 pages of the source PDF (uscis-civics-100q.pdf) with pdftotext and read the rebuilt HTML and its accessibility-report review notes in full, then compared every heading, every answer list (count, order, wording, parentheticals, bracketed notes), the h1-h4 hierarchy, and each disclosed transformation item by item.
